---
title: "Home Exercise"
---

-   Using the Nobel Prize dataset (laureates_df.csv), map the country of birth for each Nobel laureate.

-   Start with a basemap of countries downloaded using R Natural Earth.

-   This exercise will require you to use your knowledge of techniques you've used earlier on the course.

    -   You need to **summarise** the data to get a count of the Nobel laureates for each country, and then **join** this to the worldmap object.

    -   The best column to use is 'iso_birth_country_now', which is a unique three letter code for each country. This corresponds to the column 'iso_a3' in the worldmap object.
